system.description:
Also at 3rd level, your control of clones has placed you into an echelon all your own. Unlike others who dip into clone-based tactics, your level of control is otherworldly. By spending 1 Superiority die and a Bonus action, you can summon 1 Bunshin. This increases to 2 Bunshin at 10th and 3 Bunshin at 17th level.

Your clones can use the following Class features following their normal limitations and using your use limits; Cloning Maneuvers, Switch Hitter and Jack of All (Using whatever Generalization you are currently benefiting from)

Also, whenever you summon 2 or more Clones or Bunshins at once as part of casting a Ninjutsu with the clone keyword, you regain 1 Superiority die.
